rules.message: Adversarial review required: critical files were modified but no review by a different model ran. Run subagent(agent="miner-xhigh", task="adversarially review this change's diff — correctness, edge cases, error paths, security") before declaring the task done.

directives: Prose-to-structure offload (mandatory): when the request is to convert a document, notes, transcript, or list into a structured table / summary / extraction, offload it with delegate(model="draft") and review the output cell-by-cell — do not perform the conversion inline.
